## Why measurement matters

- Constructs such as leadership are not observed directly
- Multiple items can provide more defensible measurement

## Reverse coding

- Correct direction before combining items
- For a 1–5 item: `new = 6 - old`

## Reliability

- Do items behave consistently as a scale?
- Alpha does not prove validity or one-dimensionality

## EFA

- Explore latent dimensions
- Use parallel analysis and interpretable rotated loadings
- Theory remains necessary

## Chi-square

- Tests association between categorical variables
- Interpret row percentages and expected counts—not only p
